# 2Advanced Studios — Return Transmissions

> This page hosts the official return transmissions from 2Advanced Studios, marking the studio's reemergence after years of absence. Two video transmissions are featured: the 2024 Return Announcement and the 2025 2Advanced Returns + Reel.

## About This Page
return.2advanced.com is the dedicated home for the return of 2Advanced Studios. It features cinematic video presentations of the studio's comeback, along with navigation to all active 2Advanced properties.

## Videos
- Return Announcement 2024: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iV8MATpZuZg
- 2Advanced Returns + Reel 2025: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y1Z9zRCUtr8
